entries.name: Mastek Ltd.
entries.verdict: WATCH, not a buy - 10.6x TTM / 9.4x FY28E and net cash are real, but dollar revenue is falling (-0.8% Q2, -1.6% H1), margin broke to 14.4% and 12-month backlog fell 7.7% QoQ; screen added it at Rs 1,761.60, it closed Rs 1,458.30 (-17.2%); 25-point score 9.0 with critical Fails on price position, trend, base and breakout
